slackIntegration.title: Slack Integration
slackIntegration.connectedDescription: Slack is connected to your organization. You can configure notification channels in each project's notification settings.
slackIntegration.notConnectedDescription: Connect your Slack workspace to receive vulnerability alerts and reports in Slack channels.
slackIntegration.disconnectConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to disconnect Slack? All project channel mappings will be removed and Slack notifications will stop.
